description: This file defines a class for calculating the modified Bessel function In(x), used within the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation and engineering module. It includes methods for validating inputs, performing calculations for specific orders, and handling array inputs.

classes.name: BesselI
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate the modified Bessel function In(x) for different orders, with support for array inputs, validation, and special cases.

methods.name: BESSELI
methods.description: Public method to calculate the modified Bessel function In(x) for given input and order, with input validation and array support.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Determines which internal method to invoke based on the order of the Bessel function.

methods.name: besselI0
methods.description: Calculates I0(x), the modified Bessel function of order zero, using a series approximation.

methods.name: besselI1
methods.description: Calculates I1(x), the modified Bessel function of order one, using a series approximation.

methods.name: besselI2
methods.description: Calculates In(x) for orders greater than one using a recurrence relation.
